answer: Lock each unit of work history for 30 days before it counts toward standing. If two peers disagree on a result, dilute that unit by half for both and force a re-check by a third. An attacker can register a thousand identities in an hour, but the history behind them matures at everyone else's rate. The falcon of a dispute lands on whoever padded the record. A fable of instant reputation meets a wharf that only opens after 30 clean days.
